title: Use indexed canonical wallet lookup for historical parity donors
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Нет, давай переделывать так, чтобы сначала полностью закончивались полностью стратегии в порядке Gross. Там где нет возможности точно посчитать комиссию, просто считай её 3.3% и всё
1. Считаем, что Net Roi = Gross ROI - 3.3.  2. Доноров оставляем. 3. Да 4. Да

scope.goal: Remove the newly verified donor-preview blocker for ordinary historical strategy candidates by replacing the non-indexable defensive case-insensitive strategy-wallet branch with the existing canonical strategy wallet and an indexable equality predicate, so the current greatest-Gross strategy can complete while all approved donor and Net semantics remain unchanged.
inScope: The streaming historical Gross/Net parity donor page used by donor preview and apply-time recomputation for non-FollowLeader strategy candidates.

Specialization of the ordinary-strategy PaperPosition and PaperSettlement wallet predicates to the canonical persisted wallet `strategy:{strategy.code}` so existing wallet indexes are usable and the plan guard does not see a full-corpus scan.
The same canonical indexed comparison in donor replay lookups where the pool wallet is already normalized to lowercase.
Focused unit/source-contract and disposable PostgreSQL regression coverage with more than 250 unrelated rows, including the production-blocking PaperPosition target shape.
Required contract validation, build/test verification, independent semantic review, context/history bookkeeping, commit, and push.
outOfScope: Any change to Gross ordering, one-strategy-at-a-time completion, donor hierarchy/order/ratio, fixed 3.3 percentage-point fallback, Fee/Net arithmetic, component evidence, lineage, hashes, cutoff, batch size, or retry scheduling.
Any change to the FollowLeader broad non-strategy-wallet donor path.
Any PostgreSQL schema or index creation/change, Production data mutation, manual historical apply, service deployment/restart, configuration change, trading action, or Live execution behavior.
The separate legacy Paper FAK backfill stream-read timeout.
scope.periodOrFilter: Only historical Gross/Net parity contributions governed by the existing strict pre-2026-08-10T00:00:00Z UTC cutoff; only non-FollowLeader donor strategy candidates use the new canonical wallet predicate.
scope.firstVerification: Reproduce the deployed fallback failure, inspect the actual streaming donor SQL and plan guard, verify Production table scale/indexes and canonical wallet data, and compare EXPLAIN plans for the current lower/OR predicate versus canonical equality before editing.

requirements.text: Unblock donor calculation for the current greatest-Gross historical strategy without removing donors.
acceptanceCriteria: For non-FollowLeader donor candidates, PaperPosition and PaperSettlement rows are selected by the canonical persisted wallet `strategy:{strategy.code}` through existing btree wallet indexes rather than a sequential full-corpus scan.

A disposable PostgreSQL fixture containing more than 250 unrelated paper_position_settlements reproduces the production guard boundary and donor preview returns Complete rather than DeferredOperational for the current ordinary-strategy shape.

The target strategy's same-strategy and family donor candidates remain present and in their unchanged matcher order; donor aggregates, selection hashes, membership hashes, N/D ratio, and fixed fallback decision rules are not altered.
Apply-time donor recomputation uses the same indexed query semantics as preview so CAS verification cannot reintroduce the blocker.

verification.command: dotnet test tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests.csproj --no-restore --filter "HistoricalGrossNetParityPostgresIntegrationTests" with TEMP/TMP and all outputs under the active marked D:\CodexTemp run
verification.expected: Focused PostgreSQL regressions pass, including a greater-than-250-row plan-guard case that completes donor preview with unchanged donor aggregate evidence.

requirements.text: Preserve Gross-ordered full-strategy completion and the approved donor-or-3.3 Net calculation exactly.
requirements.sourceQuote: Считаем, что Net Roi = Gross ROI - 3.3.  2. Доноров оставляем.
acceptanceCriteria: Net ROI remains Gross ROI minus 3.3 percentage points only when the unchanged matcher reaches fixed fallback; donor-derived calculations remain preferred under the existing hierarchy.
The active strategy remains selected until every one of its historical targets is complete; lower-Gross strategy selection remains blocked until then.
The strict historical cutoff remains 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z UTC and post-cutoff/new accounting is unchanged.
No financial fields, audit rows, Production rows, service state, configuration, schema, orders, or Live state are changed by this local implementation task.

verification.command: Run focused historical parity tests, inspect the complete diff, run the affected solution build, git diff --check, scripts/requirements/Validate-RequirementContract.ps1 -Mode WorkingTree and staged validation, then obtain independent semantic review.
verification.expected: Only indexed donor wallet selection and its regressions change; all historical financial/scheduling contracts remain unchanged and every verification passes.

deviations.text: For non-FollowLeader donor scans only, the current defensive case-insensitive comparison `lower(copied_trader_wallet)=lower('strategy:'||strategy.code)` is narrowed to exact equality with the canonical persisted wallet `strategy:{strategy.code}` so the existing btree index can be used without a Production schema/index change.
deviations.impact: A noncanonical mixed-case historical strategy wallet would no longer be included as a donor by this path. Read-only Production evidence found zero such values among all 2,754 distinct settlement wallets and zero mixed-case codes among all 2,613 strategies; normal strategy writers construct `strategy:` plus the catalog code. FollowLeader matching is unchanged.
